status.summary: Read. The intercept carries garble: one block inside the text and six letters at the end.

sheet.description: One typed sheet, one typewriter and one carbon, with four transmissions separated by rules.

receipt_stamps.note: the date box is too faint to read on the image

date_note: The transmission line gives only the day and the hour. The month and year come from the ENTRADA stamp of the sheet, 8 December 1936.
sender: Comandante de Marina de Baleares (Palma de Mallorca)
body: OBAL XWWB JUKR UFUD LHEM CICJ TWYQ NCRO LYGK QLVU EPOU UYZV GYWG AKDY NLKV VMOD KPBZ FFNY YRGJ SIVL
notes: The starting position is a word, LUIS. The closing check should be the starting position reversed, SIUL; the sheet types SIVL, a U for a V. garble_check holds the rule's value and garble_check_as_written the sheet's, and either is stripped before the attack. The garble that remains belongs to the intercept: it does not move with the key, and it comes in blocks (reading AERONAVAL needs three letters of the group CICJ changed).
